newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Biosite, Wesley Jessen started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Biosite, Wesley Jessen started.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said it initiated coverage of Biosite Diagnostics Inc and Wesley Jessen VisionCare Inc with buy ratings.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Alex. Brown later said Wesley Jessen, a leader in the specialty contact lens market, is one of the best mid-capitalization ideas.
-- said new product introductions should drive Wesley Jessen's revenue growth. Said Wesley Jessen should be able to leverage this revenue growth into 25 percent earnings growth.
-- said Wesley Jessen's valuation is "compelling" at its current level.
